summary: Craft & Chill is Plant Bar West Asheville's own promotional weekly hangout: bring-your-own-supplies painting, sketching, and knitting while drinking at the bar. It is run and branded entirely by the venue, not by an independent organizer or club, and the listings invite guests to bring friends rather than referencing returning members.

evidence.note: Description frames it as "our weekly creative hangout" hosted by Plant Bar, with "Gather your pals" language typical of a bar promo, not a club invite.
No membership language, dues, sign-up form, named regulars/leaders, or links to an external community (Facebook group, Discord, etc.) across any of the three listings.

Only 3 listed occurrences over Jan-Jun 2026 with a sparse ~84-day median gap, despite being described as 'weekly' - consistent with an ad hoc bar event rather than a scraper undercounting a tight-knit recurring club.
Web search for 'Craft & Chill' plus Facebook group/community turned up only Plant Bar's own business Facebook page; no dedicated Craft & Chill group, Meetup, or Instagram presence exists.
Tourism board listing describes it purely as a casual bar activity for visitors/locals, not as an organized club with an identity of its own.
